description: Unsigned transactions to close the wallet's short on a stock: buy back everything owed, return it, take out the money held (with a USDG top-up approval if it is under water). A wallet has one short per stock, shared by any pair or basket legs on it: this closes all of it, and closes_parts lists the parts it takes with it. close_pair closes only a pair's own part.

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: close_short
title: Prepare: close a short
